summary: Contestants prepare and deliver a well-organized speech on a business, leadership, or professional development topic. The speech must be researched, structured, and presented using effective communication skills, lasting between three and five minutes. Contestants submit a speech outline, works cited, release form, and AI documentation for each round.
time_limits: No more than three (3) minutes setup
No less than three (3) and no more than five (5) minute presentation
Speech will be stopped at five minutes
submission_requirements: One (1) copy of the Speech Outline for each round (prelims and finals)
Works Cited formatted according to the Style & Reference Manual for each round
BPA Release Form(s) for each round
AI Usage and Documentation Form for each round
All copies must be printed in black ink on 8 1/2”x11” plain white paper
Copies should be collated and stapled as separate sets
No materials other than the required submission may be left with judges
presubmit_items: Works Cited formatted according to the Style & Reference Manual
what_to_bring: Optional - Easel, flipchart, posterboard and props
competencies: Communicate ideas clearly, professionally, and confidently through effective speaking skills
Organize the speech using a clear introduction, body, and conclusion to create a coherent and engaging message
Use appropriate tempo, pitch, vocal variety, gestures, posture, and eye contact to support confident and professional delivery
Incorporate research, evidence, and credible sources to strengthen key points and support the overall message
Adapt content, tone, and delivery to meet the needs and expectations of the intended audience
Demonstrate professionalism and ethical communication by using original work, citing sources appropriately, and presenting respectfully

rubric.criterion: Contestant followed Copyright and/or Fair Use Guidelines and Artificial Intelligence Usage & Citation Policy.

rubric.description: Contestant maintains good eye contact, uses appropriate gestures and body language, and varies their tone and pace adequately.
The speech content flows adequately, and the contestant demonstrates a clear and well-integrated structure throughout.
Presentation demonstrates a good understanding of the topic and includes relevant and accurate information
Setup lasted no more than three (3) and the speech is no less than three (3) and no more than five (5) minutes.

judging_notes: AI Policy Level 2 Permitted with Citation
Props and/or additional items shall not be used as a basis for scoring
Judges’ comments will be returned digitally through the online judging system at the national level
Materials submitted for technical judging will not be returned and will not be available at NLC
eligibility_notes: The event may be repeated, but the topic may not
Contestants may not enter Extemporaneous Speech, Presentation Team, or Prepared Speech in the same year
Each state is allowed three (3) entries
